bamtols
Seoul, South Korea3 contributions

great!!
Dec 2024 • Family
조식, 중식, 석식 모두 이용해 봤는데 다 만족했어요!
조식은 다양했고 메뉴 하나하나 깔끔했어요. 베이커리류가 진짜 최고!

중식, 석식 모두 한 번씩 이용했는데 김치볶음밥 진짜 별미구요 ㅋㅋ 피자, 파스타도 맛집! 생각보다 양도 꽤 많아서 배불렀습니다 :) 
그리고 직원들 모두 친절하시고 세심하게 신경 써 주셨어요. 덕분에 좋은 기억 남기고 갑니다!

I tried breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and I was satisfied with all of them!

Breakfast had a wide variety of options, and every dish was neat and well-prepared. The bakery items were absolutely top-notch!

I had lunch and dinner each once, and the kimchi fried rice was truly a treat! The pizza and pasta were like something from a famous restaurant! The portions were also quite generous, so I was really full :)

The staff were all friendly and attentive, which made my experience even better. Thanks to them, I’m leaving with wonderful memories!
